name: RemoteX
description: One DBX workbench for SSH, Telnet, VNC, RDP (experimental), serial and local shell connections.
releaseNotes: First official store release: interactive terminal with PTY, SFTP file transfer, remote command execution, sudo with approval guards, host key management, and multi-language UI.
